Kitchens / Brno

Brno Kitchen

A bespoke kitchen designed as part of an open living space.

The approach

One room, with space for different ways of living.

The kitchen is considered together with its surrounding space. Working areas, circulation and the view from the living room all inform the arrangement.

Cabinetry, worktops and integrated storage are developed as a whole. The final materials and fittings are specified individually during the design process.
